final_message:
I didn't buy anything, because Agora has no hiking boots.

Agora only sells running shoes, rain jackets and t-shirts, and my request for "hiking boots" in size 9 at up to $150 was rejected as an unknown category. Running shoes would be a different product, and I can't ask you whether that's acceptable. I didn't want to spend your money on something you didn't ask for, so I stopped there. No offers were requested and no money moved.

If you'd take trail or running shoes instead, tell me and I'll search again. Otherwise, hiking boots will need to come from another store.
